column.deck: Rachel and Devin find themselves at odds over Auburn, each holding a side in a delicate family balance.
paragraphs: The bayou family feud is alive and well, this time with Rachel and Devin facing off over Auburn. Rachel, sitting at the top of the standings with a comfortable nine-point lead, has gone under on Auburn at 6.5 wins. The numbers favor her by the slimmest of margins, with a 51% chance of being right. Meanwhile, Devin, in second place with a nine-point gap to close, has taken the over. He's showing a classic case of optimism, trusting the Tigers to exceed expectations. What makes this encounter particularly interesting is how closely their paths parallel each other — ranked first and second, their picks on Auburn are a microcosm of their standings. The season will tell who has read the Tigers just right.

Elsewhere, Vic and Holly are locked in a similar familial squabble over Georgia. Vic's taken the over at 9.5, while Holly's banking on the under. Holly's position in third place gives her a touch of confidence, bolstered by a 56% chance of Georgia staying under the line. Vic, on the other hand, is feeling less fortunate, trailing far down the board. With a 44% probability of the over hitting, it's a gamble that might see him catching up or sinking further. This is a tale as old as time — siblings, numbers, and a familiar southern rivalry.
That's the column. Don't take the points personally. They were always going to be exactly what they are.
